title: Ordinary derived semilinear calculus interfaces
statement: For a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and a strict tower of commutative ring sheaves, use its actual strict semilinear system constructions [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Define the ordinary derived calculus interface to consist of Grothendieck abelianness, componentwise exactness, exact conservative evaluations, normalized scalar adjunctions and their composition and reduction cocycle, the recorded closed tensor models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and cartesian-first-input internal Hom evaluation carrying the evaluation morphism to level evaluation. Its Hom reduction is the transpose of scalar tensor comparison, inverse cartesian reduction, evaluation and the second-input reduction. Define compatible tower scalar extension with its evaluation comparison normalized by scalar-adjunction transpose. Define localized coefficients by actual slice restriction and exact extension by zero [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], with the ordinary unit and counit component equations and the derived adjunction fixed by localization of the ordinary chain transpose. Ordinary tensor evaluation is uniquely fixed on local pure tensors. These are interfaces on the existing ordinary derived categories, with no new tensor operation and no coefficient-flatness hypothesis.
